record: Note on redaction-corpus-live-2026-10-20.json (make corpus-live, 2026-10-19T23:06Z, redactor 667ceec4). The file holds the runner output unchanged: ids, categories and booleans only.
pipeline: The Financial Agent's real client path: 11 redactions, 0 errors, 207 covered values masked, 0 covered values leaked, 6 uncovered values still masked by the redactor, 0 not measured.
sdp_only: The raw text straight to the redactor, without the client layer: 7 of 11 redactions measured; 4 batches failed, so 140 items are not measured. Of the measured covered items, 66 leaked and 1 was masked by the redactor alone. The agent never sends raw text this way: its client masks identifiers first (see pipeline).

sdp_only_failures.diagnosed: 2026-10-20T00:18Z, one rerun of the same raw requests from the agent Pod; HTTP status and byte sizes only, no body
sdp_only_failures.conclusion: The same 4 batches fail every time with 503, independent of size (422 bytes fails, 4624 bytes passes) and not a rate limit. The redactor's audit log gives the reason: its own fail-closed checks rejected the Sensitive Data Protection result (3 x RESIDUAL_VALUE at the output check, 1 x MALFORMED_RESPONSE at the inspection check), so no text was returned for those batches. Which values in those batches trigger the checks was not determined; no harness or product change was made. The pipeline path, which is what the agent uses, was unaffected: 207/207 covered values masked, 0 leaked, 0 errors.

redactor_log.source: Cloud Logging, the redactor container's audit entries (closed fields only: audit_event, reason, diagnostic.code, diagnostic.stage)
redactor_log.meaning: Both are the redactor's own fail-closed checks on Sensitive Data Protection's results (runtime/phase3/google_sdp_adapter.py): RESIDUAL_VALUE = the text of a finding was still present in the de-identified output, so nothing was returned; MALFORMED_RESPONSE at inspect_response = the inspection findings did not pass the adapter's validation.
